inherited_effects.CRUSH: Eliminate uncomminuted material into coarse and/or fine sizes without increasing sizes already coarse/fine; preserve desired plant mass and enclosing carrier components. No mandatory positive amount in both size classes.
inherited_effects.GRIND: Act on the plant-solid constituent, monotonically toward equal or smaller particle size, preserving plant mass, water/oil component identities/amounts and an enclosing paste carrier. For c,p: c_next=c-a,p_next=p+a,0<=a<=c. If c=0, no coarse material is created. Changes within a size bin remain unmeasured.
inherited_effects.FORM_UPDATE: For a standalone solid, update form class from the resulting distribution: all-fine becomes a powder stock, coarse/fine mixture a prepared bulk. A whole paste remains PASTE while its plant constituent changes. Matching remains subject to free/contained access.
inherited_effects.DRY: Remove retained carrier water from the active preparation while preserving plant solid and oil; do not identify FINE with DRY.
inherited_effects.RINSE: Use the written water supply; preserve desired plant solid and particle grade, remove extraneous dirt as required by CLEAN. Retained water is bounded by previous water plus supply; any remainder is drainage, not newly created plant material.
inherited_effects.MIX: Redistribute current prepared bulk, no new ingredient or mass.
inherited_effects.SEPARATE_BY_GRADE: Free disjoint coarse and fine branches of the current bulk; positive masses come from the explicit written inventory/named outputs, not universal grinding.
inherited_effects.LIFT_OUT: Select and move the existing branch, no disposal.
inherited_effects.SORT: Partition selected input into the two explicitly named disjoint products. Feasibility of the physical sorting discriminator is an unverified condition; no universal common sieve cut is assumed.
inherited_effects.KEEP_COVER_STORE: Retain/select/cover/store existing material; preserve mass and identity.
inherited_effects.RETRIEVE: Select existing free compatible material; absence/tie fails.
inherited_effects.SIEVE: Create designated passing fraction plus disjoint unselected remainder; their combined plant mass equals input. Refining fine input may leave both outputs fine under the previous grade threshold. Zero unnamed remainder creates no node.
inherited_effects.KNEAD: Incorporate chosen powder and written W/O into one paste aggregate; components are retained but no longer free.
inherited_effects.WITH_MEDIUM: Use contained water as medium of the active aggregate; no input event.
